read.thesis: Teva is a pharma transition story: innovative brands up 43% but generics down 15% on Revlimid loss; 2026 revenue guide raised $75M at midpoint, with AUSTEDO Q4 revenue seen down year over year and no olanzapine LAI revenue in Q4.

triggers.label: AUSTEDO channel inventory elevated, normalising
triggers.quote: For AUSTEDO, we continue to see elevated levels of inventory in the channel and expected normalization of this excess inventory in the next 2 quarters.

triggers.label: Revenue guide raised $75M at midpoint
triggers.quote: we are raising the midpoint of our full year revenue guidance range by $75 million, and reaffirming the outlook range for operating profit, adjusted EBITDA, EPS and free cash flow.

triggers.label: AUSTEDO TRx up 14%
triggers.quote: Total prescriptions increased 14% and milligram growth rose 21%

triggers.label: Generics guide flat to down low single digit
triggers.quote: we expect our Global Generics revenue for the full year to be flat to down low single digit in local currency

guidance.quote: we are raising the midpoint of our full year revenue guidance range by $75 million
we are now increasing our outlook by $50 million at the midpoint
we're increasing our outlook by $90 million at the midpoint
we are increasing the outlook by $15 million at the midpoint
We continue to expect 2026 non-GAAP gross margin to be in the range of 54.5% to 55.5%.
our operating expenses are expected to be approximately 28% of the revenue for the full year.

prior_guidance_check.quote: reaffirming the outlook range for operating profit, adjusted EBITDA, EPS and free cash flow

red_flags.label: AUSTEDO Q4 revenue guided down YoY
red_flags.quote: We also continue to expect AUSTEDO revenue in Q4 '26 to be down year-over-year due to the expected changes in purchasing patterns and pricing environments ahead of the IRA implementation in January

red_flags.label: Ex-IPR&D operating margin below prior year
red_flags.quote: Excluding MLX, our non-GAAP margin would have been 26.6%, slightly below Q2 last year

evasions.quote: Obviously, how this impacts revenue, we're not really talking about that.
So there's nothing slow or fast about it. It's just as it is.
